description: Hand-labeled claim pairs for calibrating the narrative clustering threshold. `same` means both texts assert the same checkable rumor and an analyst would track them as one narrative. Negatives deliberately include hard cases that share most of their vocabulary but assert different things, because those are what force the threshold to mean something.
